text: I can describe how the five dials (who drives, trade-off depth, operational concerns, breadth vs depth, ambiguity) generally differ between junior, mid and senior answers, and I know expectations vary between companies and interviewers.
I can give the junior, mid and senior answers to the URL shortener hot-key question, including the arithmetic (30,000 req/s on one shard down to about 9 Redis reads per 30 s).
I can open an interview with an agenda, turn a vague prompt into stated assumptions, and propose my own deep dives.
I can close a decision with my own estimation numbers, the losing alternative and a switch condition.
After every deep dive I add one sentence on detection, rollout, failure or cost.
I have a short, true experience from my own work that I can map onto a large-scale problem, and phrases for admitting what I have not done.
